    Ray tables (Part III, Setting 8.4) #

    The local arguments of Part III (local-ray-geometry.tex, primitive-ray-equations.tex, integral-partial-lifts.tex, local-ray-restrictions.tex) concern the normed homogeneous ray basis of A₀ = kP (set:projective-companion): products of rays are rays or zero, every ray has a weight in the lattice L, the categorical degree is positive on nonidentity rays, and a ray is determined by its endpoints and weight.

    We record this as an abstract finite table Tab: rays with source and target, identities, a partial associative product, weights and a degree. The rays together with a formal unit and a zero form a monoid with zero M P, in which all products of the paper are computed.

    A table of rays with a partial associative product and identities.

    • mul : R → R → Option R
